list.title: Can I use this Gummy every day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using these gummies every day.

list.title: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
list.content: While generally safe, we advise consulting with your healthcare professional, especially if you have pre-existing medical conditions or are pregnant/nursing.

list.title: What is Glutathione, and what are its benefits when taken daily?
list.content: Glutathione is a powerful antioxidant found in the body, often referred to as the “master antioxidant.” It helps protect your cells from damage, supports detoxification, and plays a vital role in maintaining glowing skin. Our gummies help boost antioxidant levels, reduce oxidative stress, and promote an even, radiant complexion.

list.title: Why should I choose Be Bodywise Glutathione Gummies?
list.content: Be Bodywise Glutathione Gummies are formulated with Opitac™—known for its superior absorption and effectiveness. Our gummies also include a blend of skin-loving multivitamins that work together to nourish, protect, and brighten your skin from within. They have no added refined sugar, our gummies are sweetened with chicory root, a prebiotic fiber that supports gut health without causing sugar spikes. It’s skin + gut wellness in one tasty gummy!

list.title: How do these skin gummies work?
list.content: These gummies deliver a potent blend of antioxidants, glutathione, and essential vitamins that support your skin's repair and detox processes. With consistent use, they help brighten, even out skin tone, and give you a  radiant glow from the inside out.

list.title: I already follow a skincare routine. Do I still need these?
list.content: Absolutely! While topical skincare works on the surface, our gummies work from within to boost your skin health at a cellular level. They complement your routine by providing the internal nourishment your skin needs to look and feel its best.

list.title: How does the Chicory Root Fibre benefit me?
list.content: The Chicory Root Fibre acts as a prebiotic, promoting gut bacteria, which in turn aids in absorption and supports overall digestive health, without any added refined sugar spikes.
